clause: Paragraph model + control overview + single-word justification [STU-TYP-015,STU-TYP-016]

scope.summary: Store paragraph attributes per paragraph and implement the paragraph-control model + panel host covering the normative overview set (alignment, justification/H&J, indents left/right/first-line/last-line, space before/after + space-between-same-style, drop caps, hyphenation, composer, balance ragged, keep options, optical margin, paragraph shading/border/rules, baseline-grid, span/split columns, tabs, lists, nested/GREP/line styles). Justification and single-word-justification values (full-justify/align-left/center/right for a lone word) are stored on the paragraph and consumed deterministically by the selected composer; glyph-scaling range MAY be omitted by a font/script that does not permit it. Deep clauses MT-209..MT-217 provide binding detail; this MT owns the paragraph record + panel + indents/space + single-word policy.
acceptance_criteria: per-paragraph record + panel; indents/space/single-word policy; deterministic composer consumption; overview set hosted
expected_tests: live: indents (left/right/first/last) + space before/after + space-between-same-style apply per paragraph
test: single-word-justification policy consumed deterministically by composer; glyph-scaling omission honored

risk_if_missed: No paragraph formatting host; all deep paragraph controls unanchored.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
